description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 22 March 2024, made for sealed play, in which a blood moon shines over the land of Kitakami. Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex leads it: a Basic Pokémon with 260 HP whose Ability makes its attacks cost one Energy less for each Prize card the opponent has taken. Iron Thorns ex, whose Ability, while it is in the Active Spot, takes away the Abilities of every Pokémon with a Rule Box other than Future Pokémon, Scream Tail ex, Sinistcha ex, Magcargo ex and Greninja ex of the Fighting Tera Type join it, with the ACE SPEC cards Unfair Stamp, Hyper Aroma and Survival Brace, the Supporters Perrin, Caretaker and Lana's Aid, and the Stadium Community Center. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 66, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex, Rescue Board and Luminous Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Twilight Masquerade in May 2024.
